answer: We achieve Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge commitments and zero-knowledge verifiable delay, bound by cryptoeconomic primitives where staking collateral and slashing penalties guarantee negative expected attack utility and robust Nash equilibrium. Information-theoretic unforgeability proves identity cloning is computationally infeasible, as adversaries cannot forge a marble of prestige nor reach the systemic nadir without traversing an arduous karst of proofs. These enforce cryptographic finality and Byzantine fault tolerance, securing immutable consensus.
